summary: This bill disapproves a rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services regarding the Affordable Care Act's marketplace integrity and affordability, rendering the rule without force or effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly disapproves a rule from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services related to the Affordable Care Act's Marketplace. This directly impacts the regulation and functioning of healthcare markets established by the ACA, pushing towards less government regulation of the ACA marketplace.
